label: bug

Thanks for the report. This looks like a real bug: when an export request fails, the Export button's "busy" state (driven by the "ui.export.busy" / "Exporting..." label) isn't being reset back to its enabled state, leaving it greyed out until a full page reload. The fix should ensure the export-triggering code resets the button's disabled/busy state in its error handler, not just on success. I wasn't able to pin down the exact component file from the available search results (only the i18n string table turned up), so further investigation is needed to locate the export button's click handler/state logic.
